profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Earthmover | Infrastructure, reliability and cloud cost for data platforms | Icechunk, AWS, Databricks | Ex-Capital One, Sync Computing, Coiled
profile.summary:
Startup full stack specialist. That means going far beyond just knowing "backend and frontend". I aim to empower everyone at a startup not just engineers, whether that is choosing a CRM, cloud deployment architecture, or the choice of where you keep your code!

These things all have to work in harmony and the wrong choice can leave everyone waiting on overloaded engineers, a killer a small company!

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Infrastructure. Reliability. UI/UX. Figuring out why DNS resolution was failing for a specific Italian ISP.

positions.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Post-acquisition, led the complete rebuild of Sync Computing’s Databricks cost optimization platform into Capital One’s internal AI ecosystem (“Slingshot”), just in time for the Databricks AI Summit.

Re-architected the entire product to align with Capital One’s rigorous security, compliance, and infrastructure standards. This involved rewriting major portions of the application, navigating complex enterprise constraints, and integrating deeply with internal tooling.

Drove end-to-end delivery across infrastructure, backend services, and frontend components. Collaborated with platform, security, and product teams across the org to launch a production-ready platform under aggressive timelines.

Now used by Capital One and other Fortune 500 companies to reduce Spark and cloud compute costs using AI-driven recommendations.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Redesigned and rebuilt the platform’s monitoring and infrastructure stack to handle enterprise-scale workloads under tight timelines. This overhaul enabled a large enterprise customer onboarding and positioned the product for acquisition.

Drove critical backend and infra improvements that laid the groundwork for successful integration into Capital One post-acquisition.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Drastically reduced churn with analytics directly feeding information to support engineers, switching user support from a reactive footing to proactive that was no longer reliant on customers reaching out with issues.

Increased conversion rate with a UI onboarding flow that led users through the complicated cloud setup process.

Conceived, designed and implemented the “package sync” feature.
    - 3x faster than traditional docker images.
    - Eliminated the most common cause of errors with Dask in the Cloud.
    - 100% boost to conversion rates and delighted customers.

positions.title: Software Engineering Team Lead
positions.description:
Identified key architecture issues, planned a year long roadmap, and led a top achieving team on
a rewrite of core systems, resulting in improved reliability from 70% to 99.9% and up to 5x faster
boot times.

CI/CD and team education that allowed the company to move from deploying once a month to
multiple times a day, increasing velocity and reducing deployment risk.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Cut CI/CD runtime from 1hr+ to under 5 minutes while reducing costs 5x.

Migrated all AWS infrastructure for the company to terraform, and set up a slack-ops account "vending machine” to both increase security and accelerate developer experience.

Crypto-jacking/fraud mitigation.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Proposing features, determining technical requirements for the feature, narrowing down the best approach and then delivering excellence with the resources of a small startup. Balancing business value with technical debt.

Python, Flask,  React, AWS, Docker and all things CI/CD.

Late night brainstorming is a specialty.

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description:
Maintenance of various data pipeline tools and creation of new tools such as an App Annie data extractor.

Creation of data engineering platform SDK.

Total rewrite/modernizing of centralized subscription platform to use AWS Lambda to cut server costs 50%.

Python / AWS.

positions.title: Junior Internal Data Scientist
positions.description: Building tools and systems to allow for easy analysis of the company's internally generated data. Processing billions of web log entries in a distributed fashion. Using Python, Dask, InfluxDB, Airflow, Postgres, Grafana.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Integration of high end media systems with home automation equipment.

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.description: • Created management GUI to administrate large amounts of specialized wifi access points in theme parks across world.

projects.title: Resume Demo
projects.description: Quick full stack demo site I threw together to showcase what I can do!

projects.title: Twitchchat display
projects.description: A app targeted at the raspberry pi to provide an easy to read large format twitch chat display.
